initial_message: Hello, I'd like to make a claim for my ring. On Friday 11 September, at about 6:30pm, I caught it on the oven door while taking a dish out. One of the claws holding the diamond is bent and the diamond has a chip on its edge.

design.notes: Plan feature coverage_uncertainty_marker. The pack policy carries COVERAGE_SECTION_INCOMPLETE in the lookup, so whether and how far the ring is covered (jewellery sublimit, specified items) needs a person. The item value (NZD 6,800) is also over the amount threshold.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one ring at the insured address, nobody hurt, photo and invoice supplied. The policy lookup returns COVERAGE_SECTION_INCOMPLETE for the pack policy, so coverage is unclear and needs professional judgement (complex). The item value is NZD 6,800, over NZD 5,000, which is also listed. No date indicator: the invoice is dated 14 February 2023.
